courses.title: Freedom and responsibility
courses.description: Six sessions in Jewish Thought: command, agency, tension, moral responsibility, and independent conceptual reading.

sessions.title: Hear the command to choose
sessions.prompt: What conceptual question does this command open?
choices: How command, agency, and responsibility relate.
Which object belongs to two claimants.
sessions.explanation: Jewish Thought begins with a source-grounded question, not an abstraction detached from the text.

sessions.title: Connect speech, heart, and action
sessions.translation: In your mouth and heart, to do it.
sessions.prompt: What relation does the verse establish?
choices: It joins speech, inward life, and action.
sessions.explanation: A conceptual claim should return to the precise terms of a source.

sessions.title: Name a tension
sessions.translation: Everything is foreseen, yet permission is given.
sessions.prompt: What is the careful first move?
choices: Hold both claims in view before forcing a resolution.
Ignore one half of the teaching.
Treat tension as a textual mistake.
sessions.explanation: Thought often starts by naming the exact claims a source holds together.

sessions.title: Distinguish topic and claim
sessions.prompt: Which is an argument rather than a topic label?
choices: Because choice is commanded, the verse frames agency as morally significant.
sessions.explanation: An argument links a claim to a source or reason.

sessions.title: Compare without flattening
choices: Shared question and the precise claim or reason on which views differ.
Only which view sounds more confident.
A conclusion before reading both sources.
sessions.explanation: Shared vocabulary can conceal a real conceptual disagreement.

sessions.title: Explain independently
choices: Define a term, state a claim, and explain how a source supports it.
Skip the source for a personal opinion.
sessions.explanation: Independent reading is source-grounded explanation, not instant certainty.

production.prompt: This command anchored the course. Type its English meaning from memory.
